question: Identify the training pause marker.

sources.title: Training manual
sources.quote:
# Training pause

The training pause marker is a green bookmark. This training page belongs to the Aster bench-top circulation trainer, an entirely fictional demonstration. The pause card describes a classroom storyboard rather than physical equipment. Every colour, quantity, token and component in this passage is invented for software testing. Participants read the printed scene aloud and compare its labels with the matching illustration. No connection, adjustment or real maintenance action follows from the text. The training narrator records the selected card so that another participant can inspect the same evidence later. A changed edition replaces its earlier picture; the date on the current card identifies the edition.
